## Font submission

Font name and folder:
Original source and pinned revision:
Designer / copyright holder:
Licence identifier:

- [ ] I have the rights to distribute these exact files under the supplied licence.
- [ ] The complete original licence, copyright, reserved font names, and notices are preserved.
- [ ] `fonts/<slug>/metadata.json` follows `schema/font.schema.json`; all assets are local, declared, hashed, and from a pinned source.
- [ ] The folder contains only the metadata, TTF/OTF fonts, licence, and notices.
- [ ] I have run `python scripts/catalog.py validate` and checked Malayalam shaping in the browser.
- [ ] I used `origin: "community"`; I have not claimed this is a complete or verified Mashi editor export without checking.
- [ ] I have included any shaping/coverage limitations in the description.
- [ ] No personal handwriting samples, photos, private glyph data, executable code, or unrelated files are included.

### Font coverage / limitations

Describe conjuncts, chillus, vowel signs, punctuation and any known missing glyphs.

### Preview check

Describe what you typed and tested. A screenshot is optional.

Maintainers: check rights, upstream hashes, actual Malayalam rendering, and attribution before merging. Passing automation does not approve or merge this PR.
